translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: ka anadwok ni Juda gi Jerusalem mwandugi mane olalnegi.
mi akelgi mwalo e Holo mar paw Jehoshafat.
Kanyono ema anangʼad nigi e bura,
kuom girkeni mara, ma gin joga ma jo-Israel,
nikech negikeyo joga e kind pinje
kendo negiloko ohala mar hono yawuowi ka giwilo gi ochode;
nyiri to negiuso ka giwilo gi divai,

content: “Yaye, jo-Turo gi jo-Sidon, kod joma odak e gwenge mag Filistia, ulawa nangʼo? Koso uchulona kuor nikech gimoro masetimo? Ka uchulona kuor to abiro dwoko timbeu e wiwu uwegi kuom gima usetimo moruyore kendo mapiyo.
Nimar usekawo fedha gi dhahabu mara, kendo usedar gi mwanduga mabeyo mogik e hekalu mau.
Ne uuso jo-Juda gi Jerusalem ne jo-Yunani, eka utergi mabor gi pinygi mane onywolgie.
“Neuru, abiro wakogi ka agologi kuonde mane uusogie, kendo naket e wiwu uwegi gima usetimo.
Abiro miyo jo-Juda ngʼiewo yawuotu, gin to giniusgi ne jo-Sabea, ma en piny mabor miwuoro,” Jehova Nyasaye osewacho.

content.text: Jolweny magu duto oikre ne kedo!
Jokedo duto mondo osudre machiegni mondo gitug lweny.
Ngʼat ma ngoro mondo owach niya,
Biuru piyo, un ogendini duto moa kuonde duto,
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye kel jokedo magi olor kanyo!
mondo angʼad bura ne pinje duto moa koni gi koni.
Mano oganda maduongʼ manade, mano kaka gingʼeny
ka ginie holo ma en kar ngʼado bura!
Nikech odiechieng Jehova Nyasaye chiegni chopo
to Jehova Nyasaye nobed kar pondo mar joge;
“Eka unungʼe ni An, Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachu,
ogendini mamoko ok nochak omonje kendo.
“Odiechiengʼno divai manyien nochwer kawuok ewi gode;
kendo chak nomol kawuok ewi thuche,
Soko nomol koa e od Jehova Nyasaye
kendo pi moaye sokono biro mol e holo mar Shitim.
Misri nobed piny ma ji odar oweyo,
kendo Edom nobed piny ongoro maonge tich,
nikech timbe mahundu mane otimone jo-Juda,
mane gichweroe remo maonge ketho e pinygi.
Juda nobed kama ji odakie nyaka chiengʼ
kendo Jerusalem bende tienge gi tienge.
